As a New Patient Nurse, you will be the first clinical point of contact for patients seeking cannabis-based medical treatment. You will conduct structured video consultations to gather medical histories, assess suitability, and determine whether a patient is ready to progress to one of our consultants. jobs.title: Multibody Dynamics Analyst
jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. We want you as a talented and experienced Mechanism Engineer to help us in our mission by designing, manufacturing, testing and delivering, fully inhouse mechanisms for Nyx. The candidate will be responsible for performing multibody dynamic simulation analysis and structural analysis for components and systems. They’ll need a strong understanding of kinematics, statics, material mechanics, stress, and mass properties. Key Responsibilities Own the multibody dynamic analysis across the Nyx program to drive design aspects of the program and systems/subsystems teams. Model, simulate, and verify the Nyx vehicle level separation kinematics/dynamics from the launch vehicle, as well as the capsule to service module separation. Perform kinematic analysis of deployment, release, and articulated systems, including motion envelopes, clearances, and interference checks. Support testing and use test data to correlate simulation models. Perform Finite Element Model (FEM) analysis on various subsystems and their components to assess strength, stiffness, and margins of safety. Perform acceleration, shock, and random and sine vibration, and derive environmental requirements for components. Document analysis results in clear reports and present them at design reviews and to stakeholders. Develop reusable analysis methods, tools, and automation for current and future programs.
